routes.name: Visa-free entry
routes.summary: Citizens of 71 countries can enter Guyana without a visa, including the US, UK, Canada, Ireland, most of the EU, India, China and Brazil. Some entries have stay limits or only cover certain passport types.

other: Check the official list for your passport, some listings have stay limits or only cover diplomatic or official passports

sources.label: Guyana Ministry of Foreign Affairs, visa information

routes.name: Visitor Visa (on arrival)
routes.summary: For nationals who need a visa and cannot apply at a Guyanese mission. Covers tourism and short non-work stays like meetings or training. Issued on arrival.

other: Two photos, sponsor or hotel details, invitation letter, proof of funds for 30 days

stay.note: Up to two extensions of one month each. Page also lists a 1 year multiple entry option.

sources.label: Guyana MFA, Immigration Procedures and Visa Fees

routes.name: Employment Visa and Work Permit
routes.summary: Issued on arrival with a work permit once the employer registers you with the Ministry of Home Affairs. Valid three years and renewable.

other: Employer must be a registered business compliant with NIS and GRA rules and must submit your details before you arrive

sources.label: Guyana MFA, Immigration Procedures and Visa Fees

routes.name: Student Visa
routes.summary: For studying at a Guyanese institution. The school sends the acceptance letter directly to the Ministry before you arrive.

other: School must submit your acceptance letter to the Ministry

sources.label: Guyana MFA, Immigration Procedures and Visa Fees

routes.name: Business Visa
routes.summary: For setting up a business, attending meetings, training staff on imported machinery, or missionary volunteering. Valid five years.

other: Company and representative details and local contact, or a sponsor or mentor plus proof of business credentials from home

sources.label: Guyana MFA, Immigration Procedures and Visa Fees
